title: Planet 9 — Cinematography & Visual Production Studio
description: Freelance website for a Lagos cinematography and visual production studio. Cinematic dark UI with a filterable portfolio of films and photography, clear services, and booking calls to action throughout. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

title: TradeWithNifemi — Trading Signals Hub
description: Freelance landing page for a trading signals and account management service. Built with React and Tailwind, featuring interactive performance charts, responsive dark UI, and contact form components throughout.

title: Cravue — Brand Marketing Platform
description: Freelance frontend for a brand marketing agency. Responsive platform UI built with React and CSS, featuring custom API integration for form submissions and a clean, conversion-focused layout shipped end to end.
